paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Rav Ketina, to Rav Yosef; I did not find it. Rabbah bar bar Hana arranged his son's match at the house of Rav Shmuel bar Rav Ketina: Berakhot 47a. Perhaps Rav Daniel was his brother; see his entry.
